title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 1: Identity and description
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.en: I am a student of Spanish.
My teacher is from Mexico.

sentences.target: El curso es por la tarde.
sentences.en: The course is in the afternoon.

sentences.target: Somos seis personas en el grupo.
sentences.en: There are six of us in the group.
The classes are short.
Are you the new classmate?

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 2: Saying and telling
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.en: I say my name when I enter.
The teacher says good morning.
What do you say when you do not understand?
We say that we need help.
My classmates say the answer.
Can you say it again?

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 3: Location and temporary conditions
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.en: I am in the library.
My sister is at home.

sentences.target: Los libros están sobre la mesa.
sentences.en: The books are on the table.
We are ready to study.
Are you tired today?
The door is open.

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 4: Possession and expressions
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.en: I have a new notebook.
My brother is twenty years old.
We have class at nine.
Today I am very hungry.
Do you have time to eat?
They have to leave early.

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 5: Doing and making
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.en: I do my homework at home.
My friend makes a list.
We ask questions in class.
What do you do after work?
It is cold today.
My parents make dinner.

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 6: Auxiliary haber and hay
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Hay una farmacia en esta calle.
sentences.en: There is a pharmacy on this street.

sentences.target: Hay dos personas en la entrada.
sentences.en: There are two people at the entrance.

sentences.target: No hay agua en la botella.
sentences.en: There is no water in the bottle.
Is there a free table?

sentences.target: He comprado pan para la cena.
sentences.en: I have bought bread for dinner.
We have finished the homework.

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 7: Going and planning
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.en: I go to the market on foot.

sentences.target: Mi amiga va a la estación.
sentences.en: My friend goes to the station.
We are going to buy fruit.
Are you going downtown today?
My parents go by bus.

sentences.target: Después voy a preparar la cena.
sentences.en: Afterward I am going to prepare dinner.

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 8: Seeing and watching
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Veo las montañas desde mi ventana.
sentences.en: I see the mountains from my window.
Do you see the blue building?
My brother watches a movie.

sentences.target: Vemos a nuestros amigos los viernes.
sentences.en: We see our friends on Fridays.

sentences.target: Ellos ven el mapa en el teléfono.
sentences.en: They look at the map on the phone.

sentences.target: No veo bien sin mis lentes.
sentences.en: I cannot see well without my glasses.

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 9: Giving and fixed expressions
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Doy mi número a una compañera.
sentences.en: I give my number to a classmate.
She gives me a sheet of paper.
We thank the teacher.
Will you give me a glass of water?

sentences.target: Mis vecinos dan un paseo por la tarde.
sentences.en: My neighbors go for a walk in the afternoon.
This window faces the courtyard.

title: Spanish Frequent Verbs foundation 10: Knowing information and skills
subtitle: Spanish with English support

sentences.target: Sé la dirección de la escuela.
sentences.en: I know the address of the school.
My sister knows how to swim.

sentences.target: No sabemos a qué hora empieza la clase.
sentences.en: We do not know what time the class begins.
Do you know where the stop is?
They know how to make this soup.

sentences.target: Ahora sé cómo llegar al centro.
sentences.en: Now I know how to get downtown.
